Arrears Ratio.value: the aggregate current balance of the loans that are 3 or more months in arrears divided by the aggregate current balance of the portfolio, on the last day of a collection period

Cumulative Loss Ratio.value: the aggregate of all realised losses since the Issue Date divided by the current balance of the portfolio on the Issue Date

Realised Loss.value: the amount by which the balance of a loan exceeds the proceeds of enforcement after the property has been sold

Principal Deficiency Ledger.value: a ledger, one sub-ledger per class, recording realised losses and principal used to pay revenue items, cleared from Available Revenue Receipts

Step-Up Date.value: the Interest Payment Date in July 2031, after which the margins step up and the Issuer may redeem all the Notes
